BUILDPLAN.md T-17 (M3).

Dedupe: exact hash, normalized-AST fingerprint, near-duplicates by token-bigram Jaccard at the configured threshold (D-13) to the review queue, persistent history with visible size

Criteria: AC-14–18
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14
BUILDPLAN notes: Serialized on `pyproject.toml`

Orchestrator notes: Writes `review.near_duplicate_of` (F-8 ruling); T-18 reads it.

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: READY PQ-22 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/dedupe HEAD b4d946c9baf07c0e833c0b084ffec8a63a8ad7cd BASE b4d946c9baf07c0e833c0b084ffec8a63a8ad7cd MODE active

FINDING PQ-22 (contract tension, for T-14's owner): pipeline/tests/test_migration.py:90 asserts bank/history.json equals migrate_mvp's output, which is the empty History shape, and migrate_mvp.main() rewrites history.json empty. AC-17 requires dedupe to grow that file, so committing a filled history turns just test red, and so will the first real dedupe run in the repo. Side taken in PQ-22: bank/history.json stays as committed; every dedupe run syncs the history from the bank in memory (and writes it on a real run), so no check misses a bank question and a reset history heals itself. Suggested fix, not mine to make (test_migration.py is not cleared for PQ-22): narrow that assertion to the shape (version + the three keys). Continuing.

ORCHESTRATOR: PRs #9 (shared web layer) and #10 (bank format) merged to main: 36250b3 then 238146e. main now carries web/shared/** and the bank format. Their branches were auto-deleted. Rebase onto origin/main (git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main), base your PR on main, and read web/shared/typemodel.js from main rather than the old branch.

PAUSED PQ-22 by the client (weekly quota). State: 3 signed commits on ai-c11-cc/dedupe (HEAD f6a8971, not pushed). Code review round 1 = FAIL (Critical: comma-after-} rule equated a compiling program with one that does not). Fix is written but UNCOMMITTED in the worktree: glued compound operators, commas dropped only where optional, dangling/inner doc-comment markers, std-named members never renamed, leading-pipe or-pattern fix, 14 new never-the-same controls + 10 same controls; just test green, 226 pipeline tests, 0.97 s. Remaining: fix the Token docstring (says jointness never reaches the fingerprint - now false) and the module 'misses' paragraph, commit, re-review (cycle 2 of 2), validation attach, push, PR.

ORCHESTRATOR RULING on your FINDING (test_migration.py:90 vs AC-17): T-14 is merged and closed, so the fix is yours. pipeline/tests/test_migration.py is CLEARED for PQ-22 for that one assertion only: narrow it to the History shape (version + the three keys), not the contents, and say so in the PR body under deviations. Your side (history stays as committed; every run syncs from the bank in memory; a real run writes it) stands. This takes effect when the client resumes your tab; until then stay paused.
